upheld.title: Formatting-only re-indentation of two untouched lambdas
upheld.detail: Commit 097cb8c8 (precheck auto-fix) moved the /catalogtypes and /catalogbrands lambdas from 12 to 8 spaces. Their content did not change. The lambda now sits less indented than its own [ProducesResponseType] attribute line and the .WithName chain, unlike every other route registration in MapCatalogA
upheld.requirement: pr-check-style rule 4: whitespace-only or formatting edits to lines the change does not otherwise touch are unrelated changes
upheld.evidence: opus: src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:91 and :98 (diff.patch hunk @@ -88,14 +88,14 @@; git show --stat 097cb8c8 shows only CatalogApi.cs)

dismissed.title: Byte-order mark added to an untouched first line
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. .editorconfig:21 declares charset = utf-8-bom, so adding the BOM makes the file conform to the repository's own settings. It is not an unrelated edit to revert.
